description: Source code implementing VRB to PRB allocation logic for 5G NR, including methods for creating VRB masks and converting them to CRB masks and indices.

classes.name: rb_allocation
classes.description: Class managing resource block (RB) allocation, including creation of VRB masks and conversion to CRB masks and indices.

methods.name: make_type0
methods.description: Creates an RB allocation from a VRB bitmap and optional configuration.

methods.name: make_type1
methods.description: Creates an RB allocation starting at a specific RB with a given count and optional configuration.

methods.name: make_custom
methods.description: Creates an RB allocation from a list of VRB indexes and optional configuration.

methods.name: get_crb_mask
methods.description: Returns the CRB mask for a given bandwidth part start and size.

methods.name: get_crb_indices
methods.description: Returns the CRB indices for a given bandwidth part start and size.
